deploybot: Deploy started -> env=prod service=runtime image=runtime:v2.4.1 commit=bd9f4a1a (Paul) PR #2345 https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345
sarah: Who authored that commit? Is this the KV cache + batching change you mentioned in staging?
paul: Yep, that was me. KV cache reuse + continuous batching adjustments. CI passed; staging had a flaky e2e that I was investigating (timeout on large context).
jen: Heads up — we're in a 2-hour change window but traffic spike expected in ~30m. If anything looks off we should consider pin/rollback quickly. :clock3:
oncall-sre: Seeing a 2% increase in 5xx on model-router starting ~5m after deploy, error rate trending up to 3.8% over last 3m :warning:
mike: Can someone confirm the exact SHA to roll back to? I propose pinning to 7c2a9b3 (runtime:v2.4.0) which was the previous prod image.
sarah: Listing the recent commits for postmortem capture: bd9f4a1a - Paul - PR#2345 - KV cache/batching tweaks; 7c2a9b3 - release v2.4.0 - stable; e3d4c5b2 - infra lint fixes.
paul: I can open a quick changelog note and attach the staging e2e logs. Also I'll be available to debug if we keep this live.
mike: Rolling back now. Initiating rollback to 7c2a9b3 — reason: spike in model-router 5xx. Initiated by mike via release CLI.
deploybot: Rollback started -> env=prod service=runtime from=bd9f4a1a to=7c2a9b3 initiated_by=mike link=https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/deploys/rollback/1839421120

```

oncall-sre: Metrics returning to baseline, 5xx back to ~0.3% after rollback. Monitoring for 10m.

jen: Thanks all. I'll open the postmortem ticket and tag @paul for context + attach the staging e2e logs. For the release notes, mark bd9f4a1a as reverted pending further investigation.
paul: Will add notes and the failing test stacktrace to the ticket shortly.
sarah: Keeping this thread for the audit log. Adding the commit/PR refs to the ticket now
